name: Mysterious Stranger
oracle_text:
Flash
When this creature enters, for each graveyard with an instant or sorcery card in it, exile target instant or sorcery card from that graveyard. If two or more cards are exiled this way, choose one of them at random and copy it. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, for each graveyard with an instant or sorcery card in it, exile target instant or sorcery card from that graveyard.

needs.what: a target spec whose size is mandatory and set by the board: exactly one target instant or sorcery card from EACH graveyard that holds one (no two from the same graveyard, none skipped), so the caster cannot leave a graveyard out
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `one_per_player` caps a caster-sized choice (the loader requires count 'any' or up_to), so it says 'up to one from each graveyard' and lets the controller skip graveyards, which changes whether two or more cards get exiled and so whether the random copy happens; a fixed count cannot follow the number of qualifying graveyards. The rest of the sentence looks expressible (exile with `as`, an `if` on the count of that binding >= 2, `cast_copy` over the binding with `random` and `optional`), so only the targeting is blocked
